title: Hard Hat Economics: Navigating a gloomy construction economy
summary: In this first installment of our Hard Hat Economics blog series, Dr. Anirban Basu provides a broad, high-level "year-in-review" to set the stage for where the U.S. economy stands today and what contractors can look forward to in the months ahead.
